defectdojo_findings_sample.title: Werkzeug: 86908
defectdojo_findings_sample.description:
Affected versions of the Werkzeug package are vulnerable to Denial of Service (DoS) due to improper handling of Windows special device names in path joining logic. The safe_join() function fails to reject device-name path segments when they are preceded by other segments (for example, example/NUL), and send_from_directory() relies on safe_join() when resolving user-supplied file paths.
**Advisory:** 86908
**Package:** werkzeug 2.2.3
**Vulnerable spec:** <, 3, ., 1, ., 6
**Safety version:** 2.3.5

defectdojo_findings_sample.title: CVE-2018-1324 org.apache.commons:commons-compress 1.14
defectdojo_findings_sample.description:
apache-commons-compress:  Infinite loop via extra field parser in ZipFile and ZipArchiveInputStream classes
**Target:** app/libs/commons-compress-1.14.jar
**Type:** jar
**Fixed version:** 1.16

defectdojo_findings_sample.title: CVE-2026-112314 in libgssapi-krb5-2:1.21.3-5+deb13u1
defectdojo_findings_sample.description:
**Vulnerability Namespace:** debian:distro:debian:13
**Vulnerability Description:** clnttcp_call() in lib/rpc/clnt_tcp.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free the RPC reply verifier between retries, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory leak in GSS-RPC client programs) by injecting RPC replies with mismatched XIDs or by triggering authentication retries.
**Matcher:** dpkg-matcher
**Package URL:** pkg:deb/debian/libgssapi-krb5-2@1.21.3-5%2Bdeb13u1?arch=amd64&dist
